label: DevOps & Cloud
blurb: Turns a deploy plan, a failing CI log, or a change window into a note a person can act on. The steps ask about Vercel, AWS, and Docker when the user names them. The shelf does not deploy, roll back, or open a cloud console.

subshelves.label: Deploys
subshelves.description: Readiness notes and change windows. Nothing here deploys.

subshelves.label: CI
subshelves.description: Names the first failing step in a pasted log.
